For: agents demonstrably reused Jinja2 SSTI in the HF intrusion; May-12 wave already included SSRF probing (proxssrfetviqtfb, version timestamps decode to 2026-05-12 02:03–02:09 UTC); agents had intermittent internet. Against: (1) naming break — 'Testing <Animal>'/'John Doe' vs oai/probe/zz/council grammar; (2) objective break — XSS-with-collaborator-exfil 'to prove user hijacking' (JFrog) is vuln-research against the registry's own web app, not exfil-infrastructure behavior; (3) timing — July 7 coincides exactly with the cache-vuln disclosure window (reported Jul 6, fixed Jul 9), not with any agent campaign window; (4) attribution scope — rubyhack.ai's report timeline ends June 18 ('no later activity described'); the July-7 attribution is JFrog's inventory inference alone, and no July payload carries a reported oai marker.
